papers.key_result: 2023 Soccer Prediction Challenge (51 leagues, 300k+ matches; 736-match test set): Berrar pi-ratings alone beat every deep model on exact-score RMSE (1.0047 vs TE+MLP 1.5063, XGBoost+Berrar 1.0212). Validation RPS: CatBoost+pi 0.2085 vs Inception+TE+MLP 0.2098, historical W/D/L baseline 0.2303. Challenge: authors' entries 1.8169 RMSE (winner 1.6235), 0.2195 RPS (bookmaker model 0.2063).
papers.title: Evaluating Soccer Match Prediction Models: A Deep Learning Approach and Feature Optimization for Gradient-Boosted Trees

papers.key_result: MOVDA: E_MOV = α·tanh(β·ΔR)+γ+δ·I_HA; update R'_A = R_A + K(S_A−E_A) + λ·(TMOV−E_MOV). NBA 13,619 games 2013–2023: MOVDA accuracy 63.32 / Brier 0.2258 / convergence 166 games vs TrueSkill 62.66 / 0.2294 / 192 and Glicko-2 63.18 / 0.2264 / 189. Paper's own ablation table disagrees (63.24/0.2259); abstract percentage claims do not reproduce from its tables; '34 teams' unexplained; code on request only.
papers.title: Beyond Winning: Margin of Victory Relative to Expectation Unlocks Accurate Skill Ratings

papers.key_result: Women's club handball (3,260 train games 2019–2023, 250 test Apr–Jun 2023). COM-Poisson latent strengths s_a=log(λ_a)/ν_a, s_d=ν_d/log(λ_d) as SEL features: RF accuracy 60.11%→81.32% (Brier 0.4837→0.3145), CatBoost 58.29%→79.57%, XGBoost 57.51%→73.57%. CatBoost+SEL regression: home RMSE 3.79/MAPE 10.94%, away 3.73/12.06%. As-of-date provenance of strengths unstated — +21pp jump is a leakage signature; single 250-game test window.
papers.title: Prediction of Handball Matches with Statistically Enhanced Learning via Estimated Team Strengths

papers.key_result: Labouchere (any initial list): expected largest bet E[B*] = ∞ iff win probability p ≤ 1/2; finite iff p > 1/2 — solves the Grimmett & Stirzaker [GS01] open conjecture. General (−2,1)-list systems: same phase transition (Thm 1); fair-game moment boundary E[B*(1∨log B*)] = ∞ but E[B*(1∨log B*)^−(1+ε)] < ∞ for all ε > 0 (Thm 3); fair-game E[B*]=∞ under vanishing/bounded-below bet proportions (Thm 2). Recovered: Fibonacci (Ethier 2010) and St. Petersburg/martingale as special cases. Proof via Doob maximal inequality, Fenchel–Young, and change of measure dP/dQ ≤ Cρ^n (ρ<1) for p>1/2.
papers.title: Expectation of the Largest bet size in Labouchere System
